assets.prompt: Use case: historical-scene. Asset type: cinematic illustration used as a website video poster and devotional campaign photograph. Create a wide 16:9 cinematic photorealistic artistic depiction of Jesus, a Middle Eastern man in his early thirties with dark brown wavy shoulder-length hair and a natural beard, wearing a plain textured undyed linen robe. He is near the RIGHT third of the frame in a quiet ancient olive grove at sunset, looking gently toward the camera and extending a hand in a welcoming subtle gesture. Warm amber sunlight softly crosses his face, shadows are espresso brown; olive branches and deep shadow on the left give ample dark negative space. Quiet, human, comforting, very natural film photography, no halo, no supernatural effects, no violence or blood, no writing, no text, no watermark. Beautiful soft highlights and real fabric texture. The scene should feel hopeful and sincere, never like a stock portrait.
